integrity: All minimum-set classes are proved by exhaustive local arm-state analysis. Accompanying finite checks are corroborative only; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only spiders whose arms all have exactly two or three edges; no all-size super domination polynomial or general-tree enumeration; a possibly relevant 2024 chapter was inaccessible for full-text comparison.
title: Minimum super dominating sets in spiders with two- and three-edge arms
